name: HaluEval-Wild
description: HaluEval-Wild is a benchmark designed to evaluate hallucinations of large language models in real-world, dynamic user-LLM interactions. It collects adversarially filtered user queries from ShareGPT and categorizes hallucinations into five types, providing fine-grained analysis and reference answers synthesized with GPT-4 and retrieval-augmented generation.
reputation: A newer hallucination benchmark that has been cited in recent LLM evaluation work, but it is not yet as established as older hallucination datasets.
notes: Focuses on hallucination evaluation in real-world user interactions with LLMs; uses adversarial filtering and GPT-4 for reference answers.
